senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; עָתַד)standing (cmp. עָמַד); ready, designated; in future.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 15b:3">Meg. 15ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 111b:3">Snh. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ הקב״ה להיות וכ׳</he> at a future time the Lord shall be a crown on the head of every righteous man.
Sabb. 138ᵇ ע׳ תורה שתשתכח וכ׳ a time will come when the Law will be forgotten in Israel; a. fr.—הֶעָ׳ לָבֹא (or הֶעָ׳) the future.

Keth. 87ᵃ משביעין אותה על הע׳ לבא we administer an oath to her in regard to her conduct in the future, opp. על שעבר; a. fr.—Esp. לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא (abbrev. לע״ל) in the Messianic future; in the hereafter (v. עוֹלָם).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 3b:3">Ab. Zar. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>לע״ל באין אומות וכ׳</he> in the Messianic days the nations of the world will come and ask to be converted.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 3b:18">Ib.</cite> <he>אין גהינם לע״ל</he> there is no Gehenna (hell) in the hereafter, but the Lord leads the sun forth &c.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:16">Ab. II, 16</cite> <he>ודע שמתן … לע״ל</he> but remember that the reward of the righteous is reserved for the hereafter; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲתִידִים</he>, <he>עֲתִידִין</he>; <he>עֲתִידוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 43b:4">Ber. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ בחורי ישראל וכ׳</he> the time will come when the youths of Israel shall give forth a flavor &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 152b:8">Sabb. 152ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ צדיקים דהוו עפרא</he> (even) the righteous are destined to turn to dust.

<cite ref="Yevamot 63a:7">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ כל בעלי … שיעמדו וכ׳</he> time will be when all tradesmen will turn to agriculture; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:12">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VII, 12</cite> <he>עתידין</he>, v. <cite ref="P00736"><he>עֲכִירִים</he></cite>.]
